commands.name: search-components
commands.summary: Keyword search over Maven Central components (groupId/artifactId); returns latest version, description, popularity

commands.name: list-namespace-components
commands.summary: List all components (artifacts) published under a Maven namespace/groupId, optionally narrowed by keyword

commands.name: search-components-by-category
commands.summary: Search or browse components within a category (e.g. JSON, Web Frameworks, Testing)

commands.name: get-component
commands.summary: Get full details of one artifact version: description, licenses, URLs (scm/issues), files, classifiers, categories, popularity

commands.name: list-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of an artifact (newest first by default) with publish dates and dependent counts

commands.name: list-dependencies
commands.summary: List the dependencies of a specific artifact version (direct or transitive), with scope and versions

commands.name: list-dependents
commands.summary: List artifacts that depend on a specific artifact version (reverse dependencies)

commands.name: get-homepage-url
commands.summary: Get the project homepage URL for an artifact version given its package URL (purl)
